Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1 . This case is nominated to this Court by Hon'ble The Chief Justice vide order dated 27.2.2025.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

3. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. No. 0694 of 2021, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been implicated in the present case, merely on the ground that he motivated the investors for investing the money in M/S Shine City, except this, there is no evidence against the applicant.
He further submits that no offence under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B I.P.C. are made out and trial for the offences under Sections 409 & 420 I.P.C. cannot run together.

He also submits that investigating officer was well aware that applicant was resident of 548/GN-259, Gayatri Nagar, Devpur Para, Police Station Para,
Lucknow, even then he never approached the applicant.

He further submits that shame proceeding was done by the Investigating Officer for constructing the proceedings under Section 82-83 of Cr.P.C. at Unnao against the applicant, however, he is resident of Lucknow.
He lastly submitted that applicant was implicated in 11 other cases, out of which, in three cases, he has been enlarged on anticipatory bail.
In such circumstances, applicant is entitled for protection of this Court under the provisions of anticipatory bail.

5. Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer of the applicant and submits that applicant was not cooperating in the investigation, as a result, proceedings under Section 82-83 Cr.P.C. was concluded, therefore, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of the bail application as well as other relevant documents, it is evident that applicant has categorically stated in Para 23 & 24 that applicant is permanent residence of 548/GN-259,
Gayatri Nagar, Devpur Para, Police Station Para, Lucknow, even then shame proceeding was conducted by the Investigating Officer by obtaining N.B.W. or getting order under Section 82-83 Cr.P.C.
7.
Keeping in view the reasons, as stated above, as also the facts and circumstances of the case, a case for interim anticipatory bail to the applicant is made out.

8. Till the next date of listing, in the event of arrest of the applicant, namely, Kapil Kumar Gupta in the aforesaid case, he shall be released forthwith by the Station House Officer of the police station concerned, on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-, with the following condition:-
(i) That the accused-applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by police authorities as and when required and will cooperate with the investigation;
(ii) The accused-applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts tot he court or to any police officer; and (iii) The accused-applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
9.

However, it is directed that the applicant will join and participate in each and every aspect of Investigation and will lend full assistance to the Investigating Agency, even with regard to 'discovery of fact' if and when required so by the Investigating Agency.
